key_terms.الْبَلَدِ: The city, specifically referring to Mecca

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Balad Al-Amin' in Surah At-Tin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Al-Balad Al-Amin (the Trustworthy City) is not only identified with Mecca but also deeply linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, who are considered the spiritual guardians of its sanctity. This oath underscores the divine protection granted to the city as the cradle of revelation and the focal point of the Hajj, reinforcing the connection between physical sacred space and spiritual authority.
